verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is usable without a UI through the DuckDB CLI, official SDKs (Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java), a Postgres-compatible endpoint, and the dbt-duckdb adapter. Credentials can be saved so Python/CLI sessions run without interactive re-authentication, and Flights runs scheduled Python jobs with managed secrets and logging. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), documented non-interactive token/service-account auth via environment variables, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
